summary: Honeycomb pilot: procure 12 enterprise seats, enable SCIM/SSO, and increase dataset retention
description:
Issue summary: Request procurement and onboarding for a short-term Honeycomb observability pilot for the Platform team.

Business impact: The Platform and Reliability teams want to trial Honeycomb for higher-cardinality trace analytics and event-based debugging for a 6-week pilot. This pilot will inform whether to consolidate some tracing/observability workflows away from our current stack and justify a larger enterprise purchase.

Request details:
- Purchase 12 Honeycomb Enterprise seats (team seats) for a pilot.
- Configure SSO via Okta and enable SCIM user provisioning.
- Increase dataset retention for the pilot workspace to 90 days (current default 30d).
- Billing via cost center ENG-PLAT-004; approval for up to $8,000 USD for the pilot.

Background: Platform engineering ran a feature-level PoC using Honeycomb trial accounts and observed faster mean-time-to-resolution on a simulated production incident. The trial team includes engineers from platform, reliability, and developer experience. Security needs to complete a light vendor review prior to provisioning.

Requirements & acceptance criteria:
1) Procurement: PO or billing setup with Honeycomb commercial team; invoice routing to Finance (acct ENG-PLAT-004).
2) Identity: Okta SSO integration tested end-to-end; SCIM mappings configured to sync name, email, groups, and department.
3) Security: Completed vendor security questionnaire (Attestation level: Standard) and confirmation that data residency (US region) is acceptable.
4) Observability: Workspace created, ingestion keys rotated, retention increased to 90d, and an initial sample dashboard shared with the pilot participants.

Timeline: Pilot needs to start week of 2026-03-22. Procurement and SSO/SCIM configuration should complete by 2026-03-19 to allow time for onboarding.

investigation_notes: Checked Honeycomb pricing FAQ and confirmed enterprise pilot quotes available; reached out to vendor rep (Brenda Lopez) for PO and commercial terms.

Security: requested SOC2 Type II, data flow diagram, and encryption-at-rest confirmation. Vendor uploaded SOC2 and a security whitepaper to the shared drive: https://confluence.redwood/sd/honeycomb-security-pack

Identity: SCIM attribute mapping required: userName -> email, displayName -> fullName, groups -> teamName. Okta requires a custom app; tested provisioning against a Honeycomb dev workspace successfully for two accounts.

Observability: retention increase will affect billing tier; Honeycomb requires workspace-level retention setting and may require a fair-usage clause. Confirmed ingestion keys rotation process will be supported via existing secrets manager (Vault).
Dependencies: Finance approval for one-off pilot commitment; Okta admin time to install app during maintenance window; Security approval on artifacts.
next_steps: 1) Procurement to obtain PO and confirm price; 2) Security to review uploaded artifacts and mark approval; 3) Okta admin to finish SSO/SCIM mapping in staging and run provisioning test; 4) Create workspace and adjust retention once billing is confirmed. Target completion by 2026-03-19.
resolution_notes: Pending: vendor PO and Security approval. No production data will be ingested until security sign-off. If PO exceeds $8,000, escalate to Procurement manager and Finance.
